result.summary: The PR changes the bounds check in src/bounds.ts from `index < length` to `index <= length`, which breaks the documented contract that valid integer indices are 0 through length-1 and that empty collections have no valid index. This is a correctness regression that causes out-of-bounds indices to be accepted.
